axes_frame — ANNOTATE plot op

• Data kinds: image2d × axes → image2d

• Call: import annotate; annotate.axes_frame(img, axes, color='neutral', width=1, box=True, scheme='okabe_ito', style=None) (or opsannotate.get("axes_frame"))
